description: This PHP script manages unassigning all testers from a specific build in the TestLink testing management system. It initializes page components, checks user rights, retrieves build info, and handles the unassignment process with confirmation prompts.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for various data structures in the script.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering the output page.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments related to build ID, confirmation status, user, and test project info.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI components and messages for the unassignment page.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the 'testplan_planning' right to access the page.
